I can't process a refund based on that message. Returns follow the standard procedure, and I can't skip confirmation.

To get started, please provide the email address on your account, or your first name, last name, and zip code, so I can verify your identity. Once that's done, tell me the order ID and the items you want to return, along with the payment method to receive the refund. I'll then confirm the details with you before anything is submitted.
